text_block_list.text:
Our Classic campaign begins this year.
So we gathered to decide our New Year's resolutions, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan,
do I really have to make a resolution?
choice_data_list: Not in the mood for that?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Resolutions are something you make
when you're like, 'I'll do my best!' or 'I'll definitely make it happen!', right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So Maya's been thinking the whole way here.
About what comes next in the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Wait, the ones I'm racing against are the girls who debuted the same year as me, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Then I wondered if things would stay the same as always.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I was worried you'd find it boring again...
choice_data_list: So what about outside of racing?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Is it okay... even if it's about something other than racing?
choice_data_list: Sure, it's a 'New Year's' resolution after all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then!
Maya wants to go on tons of dates!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I kinda want Trainer-chan to teach me lots of grown-up things!"
choice_data_list: So that's how it's gonna be, huh~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep, ehehe! You're the one who told me
anything was fine, Trainer-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright, decided! Maya's resolution
is officially "go on lots of dates!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I love you so much, Trainer-chan♪

"...In complete contrast to just moments ago,
Mayano Top Gun now wore a smile on her face."

Experiencing things from a "different perspective" like this will surely help her too.
All for the sake of finding that heart-fluttering moment one day.
So for now—
choice_data_list: Let's go on a date right away, shall we!
Let's go on a date right away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wooww...! Really!?
choice_data_list: Let's go make your dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I'm going, I'm going!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! It's a New Year's date, a date☆
Where should we go, Trainer-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay, I'm all for it!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, right away~♪
Let's go buy lucky bags together☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ Today I'm on a date
with Trainy until tonight☆

Her shopping spree truly showed no signs
of ending before nightfall—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyaa☆ You could tell Fuji-senpai something like, "I can't go home tonight"... just kidding~☆
...I made sure to prevent that, of course, and saw Mayano Top Gun safely back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
An osechi date...?
A date... with osechi...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well, oh well! Anywhere sounds like fun
as long as I'm with you, Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this place a little too grown-up for Maya...?
Will I be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Ryotei Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a lovely guest.
Please, make yourself welcome. Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: H-Hyep!?
"And so, I thoroughly enjoyed the osechi date with a nervous Mayano Top Gun."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan, you've got great taste♪
That totally screams New Year's☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya-chin, laaanding♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And then, and then? What kind of wish are you gonna make, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no fair, no fair.
Tell me, pleeease!

I prayed from the bottom of my heart
that the time would come when Mayano Top Gun's
true dream could finally be realized.
